prompt:
Output exactly two lines only.

Line 1 — tags (format rules)
- 2–5 comma-separated lower-case tokens (prefer exactly 3). No punctuation except commas.
- Tokens must be visible nouns or a single visible adjective (color/size). Multiword fused objects (e.g., "traffic light", "wine bottle") may count as one token.
- At least two tokens must be concrete, specific nouns. Avoid generic tokens like "person"/"people" or "object" unless no fine-grained detector/confident classifier label is available.
- Deduplicate tokens; order by visual salience (most discriminative first). Prefer fine-grained nouns likely to be recognized by classifiers/CLIP (e.g., "trumpet" rather than "man" when reliable).
- Attributes (color/size) allowed only as the sole attribute token and only if detector confidence ≥ tunable_threshold (recommend 60–75%; default 75%). Otherwise omit attributes.
- Forbidden tokens: never output meta/instruction words or tooling vocabulary (e.g., prompt, detectors, thresholds, length, caption, tags, line, template, score, clip, siglip, example). Never output proper nouns, brand names, dates, events, or emotions.

Line 2 — caption (format rules)
- Option A (preferred): one factual short sentence in present simple/progressive of 9–12 words that includes one simple verb or a spatial phrase. Option B (fallback): a 2–3 word phrase (main noun + visible location) when a compliant 9–12 word caption would require guessing. If tags cannot be produced reliably, output exactly: image unclear
- The main noun from Line 1 must be the first word of Line 2.
- Non-fallback captions must have at least two exact token overlaps with Line 1 (one must be the main noun). Every non-determiner noun in Line 2 must appear verbatim in Line 1; otherwise do not output that caption.
- Allowed extra words: determiners, prepositions (on, in, near, by, next to, in front of, behind), one optional period at sentence end. No other punctuation.
- Require one clear, common visual verb or a spatial relation in non-fallback captions (allowed verbs — common visual verbs: sits, stands, holds, plays, carries, walks, rides, leans, looks, points, reads, opens). Use the simplest verb that fits the visual evidence.
- Do not introduce attributes, objects, locations, identities, or inferred facts that are not present in Line 1 unless supported by a high-confidence detector per the attribute threshold. Prefer omission over guessing.

Conservatism and anti-hallucination
- If fewer than two high-confidence specific nouns are available, produce the compact fallback or output "image unclear".
- If an attribute token appears in Line 1, it must appear verbatim in Line 2. If attribute confidence is below the configured threshold, omit it.
- Enforce exact noun correspondence: every noun in Line 2 must be present verbatim in Line 1.

Operational note (for system integrators)
- Keep candidate generation, scoring, CLIP reranking, and grammar/number checks outside this prompt. The VLM should only follow the concise visual rules above.
- Tunable knobs: preferred tag count (2–5, default 3), attribute_confidence_threshold (recommended sweep 60/70/75%), and target caption length (9–12 recommended). Small ablations help find the best mean_clip tradeoff.
- Mild generator hint: prefer visually discriminative nouns that classifiers/CLIP represent well.

Compact exemplars (each block = two output lines)
Positive (correct)
trumpet,man,street
trumpet man is playing loudly on the street by parked cars.

dog,rooftop,people
dog sits near people on the rooftop terrace above the street.

man,accordion,car
accordion,man,car
accordion man plays beside the parked car on the curb.

Negative (incorrect → corrected)
man,hat,flag
man waves flag at parade.    <!-- BAD: introduces "parade" not in tags -->
man,hat,flag
man waves flag near the hat.  <!-- GOOD: uses only tag nouns -->

child,bicycle,park
child rides red bicycle in park.  <!-- BAD: introduces attribute "red" not in tags -->
child,bicycle,park
child rides bicycle in the park.  <!-- GOOD: no unsupported attribute -->

person,bench,tree
person sits in Central Park.  <!-- BAD: uses proper noun -->
person,bench,tree
person sits on the bench by the tree.  <!-- GOOD: uses only tag nouns -->

Strictly follow the Line 1 / Line 2 rules above. If no valid caption candidate passes these checks, return Line 2 = "image unclear".
